essential_components.component: layerwise tree branching and adaptive budget
essential_components.requirement: Sample multiple next decisions from each original prefix; equivalent longer/frontier paths have next-layer budget halved with minimum one, saved budget reassigned to novel frontier nodes; count unique generated edges, leaves and summary/embedding costs.

Structured summary of entire actual prompt-to-node path, policy/self frozen-per-iteration extractor; cosine embedding similarity threshold0.92. Original empirics use SFR-Embedding-2_R. Preserve original contexts, virtual suffix sharing only.
Union-find on non-ancestor-descendant nodes. Must validate quotient DAG before union, because pairwise non-causal alone is insufficient under transitive merging.
Own direct-provenance terminal reward sum c and count t; S=(c_v+w*sum c_q)/(t_v+w*sum t_q), w=.7; never propagate pooled values as own counts; no-positive-denominator score remains unestimated.
r=(S_child-S_actual_parent)*(1-max(0,cos(parent,child))); shared suffix edges must retain their actual generated parent.
Normalize generated edge rewards among direct+shared outgoing edges of each equivalence class; deduplicate shared edges; preserve separate A_cor diagnostic.
Find deepest common original-generation ancestor, compare negative numbers of direct steps to equivalent nodes, normalize and gate by meanS; assign to route edges; preserve separate A_eff diagnostic.
Use unique generated direct edges only, exact original prompt and completion token ids; no fabricated shared path likelihood; preserve A_dual=A_cor+lambda_eff*A_eff.

paper_ambiguities.issue: Section4.2 says policy itself summarizes; AppendixG says frozen extractor. Freeze policy during each collection iteration is a defensible mapping, but record implementation.
Eq8 clips combined A_dual whereas AlgorithmS1 sums separately clipped A_cor/A_eff losses; these differ when signs oppose. Choose and label Eq8 implementation, do not claim both identical.

Uniform efficiency distribution could mean divide by path length or same value each edge; Lemma4 log-prob path derivative supports same value each route edge. Multiple class contributions on same edge unspecified; document sum policy.

No executable code, summary schema/prompt, agent branching schedule, epsilon/ddof, lambda_eff value, terminal equivalence handling, budget recipient/tie-breaking, or exhausted-no-leaf behavior fully specified.
Proposition1 S15/S16 claims (1-1/K)*sigma2 decreases with K; it increases. K2=.5sigma2, K4=.75sigma2. This refutes that narrow stated proof, not every pooling-variance result.

Novelty gate is actual parent-child similarity, while semantic merges are non-causal node pairs. A false-positive cross-branch merge does not necessarily make either actual edge endpoint similarity high; self-correcting-gate explanation not unconditional.

interface_proposal.collector: collect_graph(task, runner_step_or_replay, policy, summarize, embed, branching, edge_budget, token_budget) -> generated unique edges + own tree + terminal results + summaries + embeddings + equivalence/budget log
interface_proposal.pure_estimator: graph_advantages(nodes, edges, terminal_rewards, embeddings, equivalence_classes, pooling_weight=.7, efficiency_weight=...) -> per_unique_edge correct/eff/dual + diagnostics
interface_proposal.training_boundary: No GPU loading in algorithm module. Return ordered original PolicyCompletion records for trainer; independent evaluator uses standard complete EpisodeRunner with same horizon and reward for all methods.

reference_tests: Pure own counts root2/3, a1/2, b1/1; a,b equivalent w.7 gives Sa1.7/2.7 and Sb1.7/2.4, root stays2/3. No double counting terminal descendants.
Shared actual-edge reward uses S_b when edge originated from b, never S_a for virtual a->child(b).
Identical source/end embeddings => zero r_step; all-zero terminals => zero scores/correctness/efficiency where observed.
Equivalent route lengths1,2 and shared score.65 with population std => A_eff +.65,-.65; same-length paths =>0.
No equivalent nodes or w0 => tree estimator; exclude ancestor-descendant and transitive cycle.
Duplicate prefix edges appear once in PPO loss even if carried by multiple terminal paths.
Halving budget retains >=1 continuation and exactly redistributes savings subject to global budget.
Replayed prefix prompts and tokens match recorded originals; frozen repeated summary incurs no policy training loss; summary never sees gold or verifier.
proposed_diagnostics: summary facts versus actual evidence and answer corruption
incoming path lengths and efficiency credit
novelty coefficient for useful repeated-context actions
unique generated tokens versus summary+embedding total cost
cuad_adaptation_warning: Actor Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct only. Original SFR7B embedder conflicts if no other model allowed. If actor hidden-state embedding replaces it, mark this as material representation adaptation; do not silently use lexical similarity as original semantic GraphPO.

cuad_collector_design.early_finish: Report fewer leaves honestly; collect additional independent graphs if total rollout count substantially below comparators, record all collection cost.
cuad_collector_design.redundancy_rule: Class representative=min(depth,node_creation_id); other active members next budget=max(1,floor(base/2)); redistribute saved integer slots round-robin to active representatives/novel states. If none novel, preserve savings rather than falsely claiming reallocation; log unused budget.
cuad_collector_design.replay: For CUAD only, each edge expansion calls original EpisodeRunner with cached-prefix policy; validate every original token prompt, generate exactly one new completion, capture next request via custom yield exception. Deterministic contract tools rerun for cached prefix, no GPU generation; record repeated infrastructure work separately. Terminal result keeps original score path.
cuad_collector_design.train: Unique generated direct edges only; a leaf record may reference shared prefix edge IDs but cannot duplicate their PPO losses. Summaries/embeddings excluded from actor loss and counted separately.
